thread:
alex.w: EVGNet (dedicated eu-west-3-pool-12) opened a support ticket — they see repeated 429s. Autoscaler is churning: scale up -> scale down every ~90-150s. Client experiences retry storms and billing spikes. Observed timeline and quick metrics below, filing here so SRE + infra can triage.

priya.n: Can you paste the timeline? curious if this is the short-burst feedback loop we saw last week with heavy batching.

alex.w: Timeline + condensed logs attached below. Key points: RPS jumps 20 -> 220 for ~30s, GPU util spikes to 95-98%, then nodes scale up, latency drops but client retries continue so after ~60-90s load drops and autoscaler scales down immediately. Repeat.

Logs:
```
[1765009100] rps=22 cpu=12% gpu=18% connections=6
[1765009180] rps=220 cpu=92% gpu=96% connections=140 auth=ok
[1765009245] autoscale: scale_up -> +4 instances
[1765009300] rps=40 cpu=20% gpu=22% throttled=12
[1765009360] autoscale: scale_down -> -3 instances
```

mateo.r: Looks like the autoscaler is using raw instant CPU/GPU percent to trigger. Short bursts cause up then immediate down. Also customer client retries amplify the tail. We should smooth the signal: moving average (30-60s) or require sustained threshold for 90s, and increase cooldown to avoid flip-flop.

dana.s: If we change cooldown to 180s and use 60s moving avg do we risk slower response for real sustained load? tradeoff but better than churn and 429s.

ella.cs: CS confirms client library retries every 500ms up to 6 retries when seeing 429 — combined with exponential backoff disabled on their side. They're willing to patch but need short-term mitigation on our infra.

priya.n: Proposed short-term mitigation:
- increase scale_down_cooldown to 180s
- use 60s moving average for scale_up triggers
- add a minimum replica floor for that customer's pool (min_replicas=4)
- temporary per-customer rate-limit/queueing to absorb retry storms

mateo.r: Agreed. Also recommend enabling prefix KV cache for that pool to reduce work per request if many similar prompts.

dana.s: I'm patching the autoscaler policy now for pool-12 via internal API.

ops-bot: action: update-autoscaler-policy pool=eu-west-3-pool-12 user=dana.s status=started

alex.w: Thanks. I'll notify EVGNet that we made infra changes and ask them to throttle retries. Can someone add a follow-up to run a 48h watch and post graphs to the incident channel?

priya.n: I'll set a 48h monitor with alerts for oscillation count >3/hour and post to #incidents.

ella.cs: I'll push customer-side retry fix to their engineers and confirm when deployed.

mateo.r: Follow-up items for eng-runtime: consider a health-score based autoscale metric (latency+p50+p95) instead of raw instant util; starts to avoid noisy neighbor short bursts.

dana.s: Patch applied. ops-bot reported success. We'll watch.

ops-bot: action: update-autoscaler-policy pool=eu-west-3-pool-12 status=complete

alex.w: Great. Closing loop — will reopen if we see further 429s after changes. :thumbsup:
